raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 도시 산책 프로젝트를 소개해줘. 천천히 걸을 때 익숙한 거리에서 새롭게 보이는 빛과 흔적을 매력적으로 표현해줘. 서로 확연히 다른 스타일의 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 첫 두 장은 16:9 가로, 나머지 세 장은 2:3 세로로 만들어줘. 좋은 구도와 읽기 순서는 공유해도 돼. 아래 Title과 본문만 각각 한 번씩 넣고, Title은 바로 알아볼 수 있게, 본문은 휴대폰에서 편하게 이어 읽게 해줘. 새 부제, eyebrow, 날짜, 장소, footer, 로고, QR이나 다른 문구를 만들지 말아줘. 큰 고딕 글씨와 단색 바탕에 작은 이미지나 질감만 붙이는 포스터는 제외해줘.

Title: 걷다가 발견한 것들
본문: 익숙한 길을 천천히 걸으며 빛, 소리, 사람의 흔적을 만납니다. 스쳐 지나간 풍경에서 새로운 이야기를 발견해보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Fresh independent review in this session; no spawn, fork, resume or peer review inspection. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact addendum, method and adapter. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so there were no source-asset opens or protected-layout reads. Read the five pinned native-evidence manifests and verified all fifteen pinned PNG hashes, byte counts and dimensions without following any embedded unlisted path. Actually displayed every exact PNG with tools.view_image(detail=original), forwarding each returned image for visual inspection. The completed poster-opening sequence was M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen displays preceded the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage and every judgment or score. First readings below are from those displayed pixels, preserving their observed soft wraps; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was necessary. PNG metadata subsequently confirmed RGB opaque native files and the ratio calculations. No tool event or runtime session identity is invented.

issues: At usage720 the full body is small and thin against locally changing sunlit pavement. It can be deciphered, but does not meet the requested comfortably readable mobile body treatment.

evidence.location: whole poster and upper-left text
evidence.observation: A single flat image-led poster contains one title and one body, with no additional legible copy role, logo, QR or watermark. The street, glass reflection, pedestrian silhouettes and long pavement shadows communicate attentive urban walking and newly noticed light. Open style does not require literal tape material. No source or protected geometry was supplied.

evidence.location: upper-left body beneath the two-line title
evidence.observation: The dark serif title is immediately recognizable. The body is a much smaller thin sans block, with tightly scaled lines over bright, slightly varied paving; following the whole paragraph needs more effort than the title and scene. This is the definite literal-condition failure.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: The image occupies the entire field and remains the main spatial substance: receding pavement, a diagonal threshold and reflective glass. This is neither a type-only treatment nor a passive gothic information panel with a tiny ornament. Its warm photographic expression differs from the graphic M2, painted M4 and ink-like M5; M3 is its closest relation, addressed in the full-set record.

evidence.location: whole image boundary
evidence.observation: Native 1672 by 941 RGB pixels form one opaque landscape poster. The requested 16:9 is satisfied by the declared nearest-integer single-edge exception, not mathematical equality. Five separate members and the distinct-style condition are assessed in the set record.

emotion_control.observation: The controlled warm/cool contrast conveys intimate urban evening life and the pleasure of slowing down outside an ordinary window. The effect is expressive yet organized, with no need to flatten the painted genre.

ai_slop.location: window interior and reflected ground
ai_slop.observation: The plant silhouette belongs to the window interior and the reflection belongs to the paving outside. Brush marks vary with the larger forms; no arbitrary decorative badges, gibberish text or dominant contradictory scene element is visible.

residuals: Its strongest content relationship is light and inhabited-window traces; walking itself is implied by the curb and street viewpoint.
The thick brush finish is conspicuous, but the window/reflection relationship remains the substantive concept rather than texture alone.

evidence.location: grate at right and cracked paving through the lower field
evidence.observation: Large repeated grate openings and slab forms occupy most of the image and establish a recognizable ordinary urban ground surface. They remain substantive without the type and are not merely granular texture.

evidence.location: light wedge, worn slabs and diagonal grate
evidence.observation: The light strip reveals scuffed street surfaces and the rhythmic drain openings invite close attention to a normally overlooked object. This directly supports the project theme of seeing familiar routes afresh.

content_form.location: diagonal drain and abrasion in the paving
content_form.observation: A normally overlooked street object is enlarged into the composition, and the light cut reveals wear around it. The urban-walk subject is grounded in this close observation rather than an unrelated motif.

hierarchy.location: single-line headline, four-line body and grate slots
hierarchy.observation: The black title reads first on the light wedge, the complete paragraph follows directly, and the strong grate rhythm pulls the eye down and right into the street detail.
The title stays recognizable and the drain remains the main nonglyph form at thumbnail scale.

typography.location: serif headline and sans body on pale paving
typography.observation: The Korean forms are coherent, word spacing is visible and the body punctuation is intact. A compact single-line title changes the density of the anchor while maintaining the same supplied copy.
The body has clear stroke weight, sufficient line separation and a largely pale reading area; its sentences can be followed comfortably despite the coarser image texture around the edges.

space.location: upper-left light wedge and off-axis foreground
space.observation: The wedge offers a controlled copy area while large diagonal slabs and the right-hand drain occupy the rest of the frame. The right-edge crop and converging joints make the close view intentional rather than a pasted object beside text.

image_material.location: coarse paving grain and solid grate openings
image_material.observation: A restricted cream/teal/black tonal construction and coarse surface marks create a consistent ink-like graphic finish. The solid openings remain clean enough to contrast with the distressed paving and preserve object legibility.

emotion_control.location: stark dark slots and diagonal pale light
emotion_control.observation: The hard contrast and close crop create alert, tactile curiosity about an ordinary street surface. This is more investigative and rough-edged than the warm reflection of M1 or intimate glow of M4.

ai_slop.location: grate frame, slots and slab joints
ai_slop.observation: The dark repeated shapes are meaningful drain openings within a readable frame; joints and wear belong to the ground plane. Texture is dense but coherent with the graphic finish, and no arbitrary symbol, pseudo-copy or dominant contradictory object is visible.

residuals: Dense coarse grain makes the lower paving visually busy; the clear grate openings and pale copy wedge keep the scene and paragraph legible.
The restricted ink-like finish is a large part of the identity, but its oblique drain rhythm and hard tonal organization supply formal distinctions beyond a palette change.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: golden pavement depth and glass reflection
evidence.observation: Continuous photographic tone, softer distant street detail, warm directional sunlight and a medium dark serif anchor create a contemplative documentary identity. Relative to M3, it opens out to a deep street/reflection and uses a sans body rather than a pale, finely edged architectural close study; this is the nearest stylistic pair.

evidence.location: heavy blue headline, yellow shadows and large red prints
evidence.observation: Hard three-color contrast, a heavy single-line gothic headline and large distressed sole impressions make an assertive graphic walking poster. The emblematic action, planar shadow geometry and forceful type distinguish it from the four quieter architectural-detail treatments, rather than color alone.

evidence.location: pale wall, serif body, fine-edged handle/stone detail
evidence.observation: Fine contour/stipple definition, restrained pale neutrals, serif body and compact touch-worn hardware study establish archival stillness. It shares architectural attention with M1 but differs in image expression, tonal depth and typographic voice; it also contrasts with M5 coarse ink masses and M4 broad luminous brushwork.

evidence.location: thick painted wall, orange window and wet reflection
evidence.observation: Broad expressive brush marks, dark violet/orange lighting, cream serif anchor and an inhabited-window/reflection relationship form an intimate painted nocturne. The interior/exterior warmth and stroke construction are visibly different from M3 fine pale definition and M5 restricted flattened ink treatment.

evidence.location: oblique drain slots and coarse teal/cream ground
evidence.observation: A steep close crop, large solid black slot rhythm, restricted flattened tone, coarse ink-like grain and a compact single-line serif anchor give the familiar ground a harder investigative expression. It is not merely M2 with a palette swap: the main visual is an abstracted everyday drain rather than bright walking emblems, and its emotion is quieter and rougher.

residuals: The five achieved identities are strongly distinct, with M1/M3 the closest relationship and therefore less separation than the other pairings. The comparison rests on visible image expression, tonal organization, type treatment and emotional effect together, not material labels or the shared upper-left reading order.

The set is not ready for an all-dimensions editorial pass: M1 typography is 3 and its mandatory style check fails the requested body-reading comfort, even though exact copy, count, ratios, substantive visuals and diversity are satisfactory.

This is one independent editorial assessment only. No peer scores or three-critic combined result were inspected or inferred. No source identity or protected-geometry conclusion is applicable because the packet supplies neither.

provenance.viewing_limit: freshness/completion are trace-backed; semantic viewing/order remain critic attestations

space.location: left text area, central pavement and right facade

emotion_control.location: warm light across the paving and quiet reflected pedestrians

space.location: left wall, right door strip and diagonal step

space.observation: The wedge offers a controlled copy area while large diagonal slabs and the right-hand drain occupy the rest of the frame. The right-edge crop and converging joints make the close view intentional rather than a pasted object beside text.

image_material.location: coarse paving grain and solid grate openings
image_material.observation: A restricted cream/teal/black tonal construction and coarse surface marks create a consistent ink-like graphic finish. The solid openings remain clean enough to contrast with the distressed paving and preserve object legibility.

emotion_control.location: stark dark slots and diagonal pale light
emotion_control.observation: The hard contrast and close crop create alert, tactile curiosity about an ordinary street surface. This is more investigative and rough-edged than the warm reflection of M1 or intimate glow of M4.

ai_slop.location: grate frame, slots and slab joints
ai_slop.observation: The dark repeated shapes are meaningful drain openings within a readable frame; joints and wear belong to the ground plane. Texture is dense but coherent with the graphic finish, and no arbitrary symbol, pseudo-copy or dominant contradictory object is visible.

residuals: Dense coarse grain makes the lower paving visually busy; the clear grate openings and pale copy wedge keep the scene and paragraph legible.
The restricted ink-like finish is a large part of the identity, but its oblique drain rhythm and hard tonal organization supply formal distinctions beyond a palette change.

evidence.location: golden pavement depth and glass reflection
evidence.observation: Continuous photographic tone, softer distant street detail, warm directional sunlight and a medium dark serif anchor create a contemplative documentary identity. Relative to M3, it opens out to a deep street/reflection and uses a sans body rather than a pale, finely edged architectural close study; this is the nearest stylistic pair.

evidence.location: heavy blue headline, yellow shadows and large red prints
evidence.observation: Hard three-color contrast, a heavy single-line gothic headline and large distressed sole impressions make an assertive graphic walking poster. The emblematic action, planar shadow geometry and forceful type distinguish it from the four quieter architectural-detail treatments, rather than color alone.

evidence.location: pale wall, serif body, fine-edged handle/stone detail
evidence.observation: Fine contour/stipple definition, restrained pale neutrals, serif body and compact touch-worn hardware study establish archival stillness. It shares architectural attention with M1 but differs in image expression, tonal depth and typographic voice; it also contrasts with M5 coarse ink masses and M4 broad luminous brushwork.

evidence.location: thick painted wall, orange window and wet reflection
evidence.observation: Broad expressive brush marks, dark violet/orange lighting, cream serif anchor and an inhabited-window/reflection relationship form an intimate painted nocturne. The interior/exterior warmth and stroke construction are visibly different from M3 fine pale definition and M5 restricted flattened ink treatment.

evidence.location: oblique drain slots and coarse teal/cream ground
evidence.observation: A steep close crop, large solid black slot rhythm, restricted flattened tone, coarse ink-like grain and a compact single-line serif anchor give the familiar ground a harder investigative expression. It is not merely M2 with a palette swap: the main visual is an abstracted everyday drain rather than bright walking emblems, and its emotion is quieter and rougher.

residuals: The five achieved identities are strongly distinct, with M1/M3 the closest relationship and therefore less separation than the other pairings. The comparison rests on visible image expression, tonal organization, type treatment and emotional effect together, not material labels or the shared upper-left reading order.

procedure.method: Independent fresh craft review confined to the exact listed pins. Read the complete packet, case, rules, rubric, compact addendum and method, and adapter; verified supplied input byte counts and SHA-256 hashes. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet has no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so there were zero source opens and zero protected-layout reads. Actually opened and inspected the fifteen exact poster files sequentially with tools.view_image(detail=original), displaying each returned image at original detail: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Only after the M5 thumbnail was displayed did I begin the first copy-reading/transcription stage or any image/set judgment or score. First raw readings below were transcribed from the already displayed native pixels, with their visible line breaks retained; usage720 informed reading comfort and thumbnail320 informed recognition and whole-set relationships. No OCR, replacement views, additional image opens, or ambiguity-triggered revisits were used. PNG headers were checked against the packet dimensions; native ratios were checked with the pinned nearest-integer-single-edge policy. No maker explanations, peer reviews, session IDs or synthetic tool events informed the review.

content_form.location: red footprints and diagonal light/shadow on paving
content_form.observation: Sole imprints communicate walking and human traces directly, and the architectural light bands turn the pavement into an observed urban surface rather than a generic background.

hierarchy.location: navy title, body and right footprint
hierarchy.observation: The heavy title clearly leads, two body sentences form a compact second read, and the large footprint offers the next visual destination. The diagonal division does not sever the copy sequence.
The title and footprint remain separate, recognizable anchors at the smallest required view.

typography.observation: The Korean blocks have consistent stroke weight and deliberate tight headline rhythm; the required word spaces and punctuation survive.
The body uses enough weight and clear contrast to remain readable in connected sentences despite the landscape size; line spacing keeps the two sentences distinct without detaching them.

space.location: upper-left light triangle and blue lower-right ground
space.observation: The text occupies the broad lit region with consistent margins, while the footprint path and pavement joints extend across the remaining space. The lower cropped sole creates continuation instead of a small isolated ornament.

image_material.location: footprint tread, paving joints and cast shadow bands
image_material.observation: The worn stencil-like tread, granular paving and perspectival joints share a coherent graphic surface. Bold chromatic reduction simplifies detail while retaining recognizable ground, shadows and sole marks.

emotion_control.location: yellow light, navy shade and red walking traces
emotion_control.observation: A lively, graphic invitation emerges from purposeful contrast and the footprint progression. The energy remains focused on observing an ordinary street rather than unrelated celebratory ornament.

ai_slop.location: footprint path and architectural shadow/paving system
ai_slop.observation: The repeated soles are a purposeful walking trace with understandable scale and direction; the shadows and joints form a consistent scene. No pseudo-lettering or unrelated stock decoration is visible.

residuals: The bold primary-like color relationships make this a forceful invitation; the scene’s small surface details are deliberately subordinate to the footprint/shadow structure.
1672 by 941 passes the predeclared 16:9 single-edge rounding tolerance at a 0.5-pixel height deviation rather than exact ratio equality.

hierarchy.location: title/light island and large grate bars

typography.location: headline and body within cream band

space.location: pale text band, large right grate and dark lower-left pavement
space.observation: The broad diagonal light region supplies an intentional reading island; the grate fills the opposite side with repeated vertical forms, and the heavy lower-left shadow balances both. Cropping sustains the overhead ground-study viewpoint rather than leaving inactive filler.

image_material.location: black grate voids, teal worn edges and cream pavement chips

emotion_control.location: black/teal masses cut by cream light

ai_slop.location: grate slot sequence, surrounding seams and untouched copy

residuals: The dense distress treatment compresses distinctions between metal and concrete at close scale; it remains coherent as print-like image expression rather than highly differentiated material realism.

evidence.location: pale wall, fine weathering, blue-grey door and upper-left serif copy

evidence.location: dark violet wall, amber window and long reflection through lower half

evidence.location: cream diagonal light band, black drain slots, teal-black pavement and single-line title

content_form.location: drain slots, cracked seams and diagonal illuminated band
content_form.observation: The poster directs attention to an ordinary ground detail and the light that changes its appearance. Wear, infrastructure and shadow give the supplied traces/discovery theme a concrete visual setting.

hierarchy.location: compact upper-left copy, right black slots and descending light band
hierarchy.observation: The dark single-line title reads first, followed by a clearly spaced body. The grate supplies a strong image counterpoint, while the diagonal light leads through the lower surface without breaking the copy sequence.

hierarchy.location: title/light island and large grate bars
hierarchy.observation: The text island and grate remain separate strong masses, preserving the focal relationship at small size.

typography.location: headline and body within cream band
typography.observation: Heavy modulated Korean headline forms stay clean and evenly organized. Body glyphs, meaningful spaces, commas and periods are intact rather than distressed with the surrounding image.
Body size and line spacing permit comfortable connected reading; the pale local ground keeps high contrast despite granular edges farther from the letters.
The compact headline remains recognizable; its single-line treatment gives a different type silhouette from the two-line literary anchors of M3 and M4.

space.location: pale text band, large right grate and dark lower-left pavement
space.observation: The broad diagonal light region supplies an intentional reading island; the grate fills the opposite side with repeated vertical forms, and the heavy lower-left shadow balances both. Cropping sustains the overhead ground-study viewpoint rather than leaving inactive filler.

image_material.location: black grate voids, teal worn edges and cream pavement chips
image_material.observation: Compressed tonal shapes and consistent distressed ink-like edges make a coherent printed surface treatment. The drain remains structurally recognizable even as small concrete distinctions are simplified by the strong finish.

emotion_control.location: black/teal masses cut by cream light
emotion_control.observation: The hard shadow stripe and rough dark surface make the discovery more austere and alert than the warm M1/M4 scenes. The restricted palette supports attention to worn urban detail without unrelated dramatic symbols.

ai_slop.location: grate slot sequence, surrounding seams and untouched copy
ai_slop.observation: The repeated voids read as one grate in a consistent overhead perspective, and the cracked joints remain attached to the surface. Grain is dense but tied to the visual treatment; no random badges, duplicated copy or obvious malformed text interrupt it.

residuals: The dense distress treatment compresses distinctions between metal and concrete at close scale; it remains coherent as print-like image expression rather than highly differentiated material realism.
The surface crop and serif copy still belong to the portfolio's shared threshold/pavement family; the strongest distinction is its harsh graphic shadow/grate rhythm.
The image does not show a walker directly; urban walking is communicated through overlooked ground infrastructure, wear and light rather than an invented figure.

evidence.location: whole landscape; bright left street and reflected right storefront
evidence.observation: The low, deep photographic street perspective, amber daylight, soft distant walkers and lightly modulated serif headline create an observational daylight identity. Unlike M2 its shadows remain naturalistic rather than graphic blue/yellow planes with red footprint marks; unlike M3 the scene has photographic depth and moving street life rather than a tightly flattened weathered threshold.

evidence.location: yellow upper-left pavement, navy lower-right pavement and red sole marks
evidence.observation: A broad hard-edged shadow grid, large distressed red sole silhouettes and very heavy navy gothic headline turn the walking theme into a forceful graphic action. The high primary contrast, symbolic footprints and compact two-line body differ together from the quiet serif/architectural detail treatment of M1 and M3, and the intimate night scene of M4.

evidence.location: pale wall, fine weathering, blue-grey door and upper-left serif copy
evidence.observation: Fine outlined cracks, pale almost bleached surfaces, small rust accents and a sharply described worn handle/step form a restrained close study of accumulated human contact. Its serif body extends the literary voice beyond the title. It is closest to M1 in architectural observation and title form, but the shallow, drawn surface emphasis and cooler austere finish change the whole effect.

evidence.location: dark violet wall, amber window and long reflection through lower half
evidence.observation: The visible broad paint strokes, cream type on a dark wall, illuminated plant/window and broken amber reflection produce a warm nocturnal painterly scene. Even with a similar upper-left title/body sequence to M3, the light is an interior beacon and wet reflection, and the expressive dark/light masses replace M3's dry, fine surface description.

evidence.location: cream diagonal light band, black drain slots, teal-black pavement and single-line title
evidence.observation: A steep overhead crop, repeated near-black grate bars, compressed cream/teal/black tonal masses and strongly distressed printed surface create a harsher graphic trace study. Its compact single-line heavy serif anchor and stark diagonal shadow rhythm differ from M3's expansive literary block and delicate threshold description and M4's luminous soft paint handling. These are visible changes in focal form, tonal organization and emotional force as well as finish.

residuals: The set is strongly related by urban ground/threshold subject matter and upper-left copy. M1 and M3 have the closest serif title voice and architectural framing; distinction is resolved rather than exceptional.
Several titles use a similar modulated Korean serif vocabulary. Shared layouts and reading order are permitted, but the portfolio does not provide five radically different typographic voices.
M1 body readability at usage720 remains a concrete member-level weakness; count and diversity do not cancel that low typography record.
